name: inline-edit
title: Inline Edit
description: Rename in place, built with definePrimitive on UI SDK's createInlineEdit: a press, Enter, F2 or typing turns the text into a field; Enter and Tab save, Escape puts it back, blur saves or cancels; validate keeps editing; agents rename(text) and cancel.
docs: `<InlineEdit label value defaultValue onValueChange validate blur startOn editButton labels size>` for a title, a list item or a tab's name. The text is a button described by `labels.hint` ("Press Enter or F2 to rename"); a press (or only a double click with `startOn="double-click"`, leaving a press to the row), Enter, F2 or a printable key turns it into a field named by `label`, filled with the text and selected. Enter and Tab save, Escape puts the text back, and focus returns to the text after Enter or Escape. Leaving the field saves (`blur="commit"`, the default) or puts the text back (`blur="cancel"`). `validate(text)` returning `false` keeps editing. `onValueChange(value, details)` reports `enter-key`, `tab-key`, `focus-out` or, for an agent, `imperative` with `source: "agent"`, and can cancel. `size` (`body`, `title-sm`, `title`) sizes the text and the field alike, so nothing moves. `editButton` adds a pencil named by `labels.edit(label)` with a tooltip, shown on hover and focus and always on touch. Agents find it by `label` and call `rename(text)` or `cancel`. Inside a tab or a row that is itself a button, compose `InlineEditRoot`, `InlineEditDisplay` (with `render`), `InlineEditInput` and `InlineEditTrigger` so controls don't nest.
